test_kvfp4_quant_dequant: test the KVFP4 quantize and dequantize functions with predefined tensor shapes
run_benchmark: run a benchmark comparing FP8 and KVFP4 quantization accuracy and timing for a given tensor shape
calculate_accuracy_metrics: calculate accuracy metrics (MSE, MAE, PSNR, relative error) between original and reconstructed tensors
batched_quantize: quantize a bfloat16 tensor to KVFP4 format using KVFP4QuantizeUtil.batched_quantize
batched_dequantize: dequantize a KVFP4 tensor back to bfloat16 using KVFP4QuantizeUtil.batched_dequantize
